BL-1535 — The mono-router chase rotates the resident away from a role that is mid-parcel: should-rotate-resident? judges busy from the pane footer alone, so a role holding a real in_process parcel whose turn is inside a detached command, or whose forward stands between the two self-audit calls, reads idle and is respawned as another role - three times on 2026-09-11 (hardender 05:29:58Z, 06:17:07Z, 07:09:38Z; one hand-rotation, one orphaned 15-minute mutation run) - the chase gate consults the departing role's in_process box and a working signal, refuses to depart a working holder for a different target, still yields an idle holder, and writes a telemetry row per refusal
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the gate lives in the chase DECISION (mono-router-lib/should-rotate-resident?, fed by handoffd.bb attempt-resident-rotate!), never in handoff-lib/rotate-re…
BL-1535 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1535" (or "reject BL-1535 <reason>") to act.
